title: Live: College GameDay
description: Originating from the site of one of the day's best matchups, with a sea of fans cheering wildly in the background, host Rece Davis and analysts Lee Corso, Kirk Herbstreit and Desmond Howard talk college football for three hours, reporting on the top teams, games, players and storylines. David Pollack and Maria Taylor contribute reports, interviews and features. Davis replaced longtime host Chris Fowler in 2015.

title: Live: College Football
description: The Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets (3-7, 2-5 ACC) host the No. 11 Wake Forest Demon Deacons (9-1, 6-1) in Atlanta. With only one loss this season, Wake Forest enters after beating SMU 49-7, while Georgia Tech beat Clemson 20-6 behind Alberto Mendoza.

title: Live: College Football
description: The No. 5 Texas Longhorns (8-2, 5-2 SEC) host the Arkansas Razorbacks (4-6, 2-5) in Austin. Arkansas enters after a 34-6 victory over South Carolina, while Texas seeks a fifth straight victory behind Arch Manning, who leads with 19 touchdowns.

title: Live: NFL Football
description: The Chicago Bears host the New Orleans Saints in NFL regular-season play at Soldier Field. The Chicago Bears have won four games straight and sit at 7-2, while the New Orleans Saints arrive at 3-6 after a recent 20-17 loss to Carolina.

title: Live: NFL Football
description: The Denver Broncos host the Las Vegas Raiders in AFC West play at Empower Field at Mile High. At 7-2 overall and winner of five consecutive games, Denver welcomes a 4-6 Las Vegas team it has beaten four straight times in the series.

title: Live: Football Night in America
description: "Football Night in America" features host Maria Taylor, former NFL head coach and quarterback Jason Garrett, former NFL head coach Mike Tomlin and NFL insider Mike Florio recapping the day's NFL highlights.
